entity.additionalinfo: The Schunk Group is an international technology group employing around 9,000 people in 26 countries. The company is a leading supplier of products made of high-tech materials – such as carbon, technical ceramics and sintered metal – as well as machines and systems – from environmental simulation and air conditioning to ultrasonic welding and optical machines. Turnover of the Schunk Group was €1.3 bn in 2021.
